title: Session not auto-logged to Redis
content: OpenCode session produced zero entries in Redis. session_logger.py and smart_log.py require explicit import/call - no auto-hook exists.
evidence: Redis keys 'session*' show no entries from OpenCode session
bootstrap.py now auto-initializes logging - verified working
5 entries written to Redis when bootstrap.py runs
Session monitor created - tracks 24 sessions, detects silent ones
Monitor can nudge silent sessions via Redis key + pub/sub
root_cause: Paradigm mismatch: bootstrap.py is USER-run (works), OpenCode is separate AI process (doesn't auto-run anything)
fix_needed: MITIGATED: bootstrap.py fix + session monitor provides detection and nudge capability
remaining_gap: OpenCode AI agents still need explicit instruction to import logger. Monitor provides detection + nudge, but agents must respond.
mitigation: Session monitor (services/session_monitor.py) now tracks sessions and can nudge silent ones to start logging.
